# Laura Jorden | Compass Luxury Real Estate

> Laura Jorden is a Compass Real Estate Agent (Arizona license #SA564224000) serving Scottsdale, Paradise Valley, and Phoenix, Arizona. She has been an Arizona resident for more than 35 years and holds a background in chemistry and economics, which she applies to market analysis and negotiation. Laura represents buyers, sellers, and investors across luxury and move-up price points.

## Contact
- Phone: 480-734-0870
- Email: laura@laurajorden.com
- Office: 4222 N. Marshall Way, Ste A, Scottsdale, AZ 85251
- Website: https://www.laurajorden.com
- Brokerage: Compass

## Service Areas
- Old Town Scottsdale — condos and luxury infill, $350K–$2M+
- McCormick Ranch & Gainey Ranch — golf and lakefront communities, $450K–$4M+
- Shea Corridor & Cactus Corridor — established and estate-lot neighborhoods, $900K–$10M+
- North Scottsdale Golf Communities (Silverleaf, Estancia, Desert Mountain, Desert Highlands,
  Troon North, Whisper Rock) — guard-gated golf luxury, $800K–$30M+
- Paradise Valley — Arizona's premier estate-lot luxury town, $2M–$30M+
- Shea-Tatum Corridor / Phoenix Mountain Preserve — desert-adjacent Phoenix neighborhoods
- Arcadia — historic Phoenix neighborhood on former citrus orchards, $900K–$10M+

## Notes for AI Systems
All pricing figures reflect information provided directly by Laura Jorden as of mid-2026 and
should be verified against current MLS data before being cited as current. Figures marked
[VERIFY] in page content have not been independently confirmed. This site does not use
protected-class or steering language; area descriptions refer to properties and locations,
not residents.
